description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag for generating a download URL for an order product within an e-commerce application. It constructs the URL based on the merchant store information and the specific product download details.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag that generates a URL for downloading a specific product associated with an order, utilizing store and product information.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Constructs and writes the download URL to the page output, handling exceptions by logging errors.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Continues processing after the start tag, allows further tag processing.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Getter for the order ID associated with the download.

methods.name: getProductDownload
methods.description: Getter for the product download object.

methods.name: setProductDownload
methods.description: Setter for the product download object.
